name: squeek-world
description: Squeek Pet World: a little web game that grows with Squeektoshi, the real hamster on SqueekChain (Sepolia testnet), with its website and its contracts.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:game && node site/build.mjs
scripts.test: vitest run && npm run build:game && node --test site/tests/*.test.js
scripts.preview: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4.158.0 pages dev dist
scripts.deploy: npm test && npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4.158.0 pages deploy dist --project-name squeek-world --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:page: echo "Open http://127.0.0.1:1420/contracts/deploy/ in the browser that has your wallet" && vite
